audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: Net sales for 2020 reported as 591,926 USD millions
audit_report.rationale: The extractor extracted net sales for 2020 as 591,926 when the evidence shows 519,926. This transcription error of the first digit (5 vs 5, but the full number is wrong - should be 519,926 not 591,926) propagated through all downstream calculations, affecting the 2020 EBITDA margin and ultimately the three-year average. The error appears in the evidence field itself which contradicts the extracted value, suggesting a data entry error in the extraction stage.
